messages:
toni: Heads up 3:30 UTC  we're seeing a spike in fncall validation rejects on payments.canary eu-west. rejects ~1% now. anyone?

ryan: saw it. top failure: `items` field is null instead of []. legacy client returns null for empty carts.

yasmin: canary is strict so these show as hard rejects. noisy dashboard.

toni: quick idea: add a `coerce_nullable` validator mode that converts known nullables (null -> [] or "") and emits `fncall.coerced=true`. chart it separately.

ryan: agree. telemetry: add counters `fncall.coerced.count` and sampled events `fncall.coerced.sampled` with redacted payload. retention short.

ops-bot: Alert: [fncall] COERCE_SNIFF route=payments/canary window=5m coerced=412

yasmin: UX: console should show a ribbon on route page with current validation mode and a toggle to include coerced in reject graphs. also a small list of top coerced fields.

sec-bot: Note: any payload retention must be scrubbed and encrypted. file compliance ticket.

toni: plan: ryan implements coercion list + metrics, yasmin wires UI toggle, ops adds lower-severity spike alert. we'll roll to canary only first.

ryan: pushing branch `validation/coerce-mode`. CI pending.

yasmin: will draft console mock. keep samples at 0.2% initially.

toni: thanks. will post RFC link after I write it.
